::: {#fig-grounding-floating layout-nrow=3}

```{python}
#| label: fig-grounding-floating-before
#| echo: false
#| fig-cap: "Coupled input: F has no external terminal."
import schemdraw as sd
import schemdraw.elements as elm
sd.svgconfig.svg2 = False
with sd.Drawing(canvas='svg') as d:
    d.config(unit=3, fontsize=14)
    elm.Dot().at((0,0)).label('A', loc='left')
    elm.Capacitor().right().label('3 pF')
    elm.Label().at((3,0)).theta(0).label('F', loc='bottom', ofst=0.2)
    elm.Capacitor().right().label('6 pF')
    elm.Dot().label('B', loc='right')
```

```{python}
#| label: fig-grounding-floating-eliminated
#| echo: false
#| fig-cap: "Exact elimination: the retained terminals see a 2 pF coupling."
import schemdraw as sd
import schemdraw.elements as elm
sd.svgconfig.svg2 = False
with sd.Drawing(canvas='svg') as d:
    d.config(unit=3, fontsize=14)
    elm.Dot().at((0,0)).label('A', loc='left')
    elm.Capacitor().right().length(6).label('2 pF').color('green')
    elm.Dot().label('B', loc='right')
```

```{python}
#| label: fig-grounding-floating-after
#| echo: false
#| fig-cap: "Grounded approximation: each endpoint receives the full 2 pF load."
import schemdraw as sd
import schemdraw.elements as elm
sd.svgconfig.svg2 = False
with sd.Drawing(canvas='svg') as d:
    d.config(unit=3, fontsize=14)
    elm.Dot().at((0,0)).label('A', loc='left')
    removed=elm.Capacitor().right().length(6).label('2 pF')
    elm.Dot().label('B', loc='right')
    x,y=removed.center
    elm.Line().at((x-.35,y-.35)).to((x+.35,y+.35)).color('red').linewidth(2)
    elm.Capacitor().at((0,0)).down().length(2.2).label('2 pF').color('green')
    elm.Line().right().length(6)
    elm.Capacitor().up().length(2.2).label('2 pF').color('green')
    elm.Dot().at((3,-2.2)).label('VSS', loc='bottom')
```

Exact floating elimination precedes the grounded approximation. Red strikes through the removed coupling. Green identifies each newly introduced capacitor. `VSS` is an explicit reference, not a new connection to `F`.

:::
